expectations.text: fonts.css loads Source Serif 4 from the fonts folder with @font-face and sets font-display to swap, fallback or optional
fonts.css declares the italic file in its own @font-face with font-style: italic, so the em text renders in the real italic once the font has loaded
Rendered at a 1280px viewport, the article's height with the font files blocked differs from its height with the fonts loaded by at most 2%
Rendered at a 1280px viewport, the paragraphs' average characters per full line with the font files blocked differ from the loaded state by at most 3%
With the font files blocked, the article text renders in Georgia (the fallback the brief names), not in another face
